description: Metadata for an npm or PyPI package: latest version and release date, license, description, repository and weekly downloads (npm). Use to check a dependency before installing. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

name.description: Package name, e.g. hono or requests

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: package_info
